Network settings (for school or work wifi)

Most home connections link the two computers directly. School and office wifi often blocks that. Your own Mini2K server fixes it: it finds the room, and when nothing direct works it carries the game itself over normal web traffic. If you opened the game from the server's address you don't need to type anything here.

Optional, a TURN relay (used before the server, if set). A free Metered account gives 20 GB a month. Only the person who creates the room needs to fill this in.

Or any other TURN server:

Multiplayer online 2v2, 3v3 or StreetBall

One person creates a room and friends join with its code. 2v2: on each team one person runs the PG and C, the other the SG, SF and PF. 3v3: one runs the PG and SG, one the SF, one the PF and C. StreetBall 3on3: half court outdoors, three a side, first to 21 by 1s and 2s, win by two, no fouls, with make-it take-it as an option. You can sit in more than one StreetBall spot on your team to run those players yourself. An open spot is played by the CPU. Off the ball, Q switches between your own players. Needs the Mini2K server.
